header.title: How to Paint a Stove Exhaust Hood
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to refresh the appearance of your stove exhaust hood by cleaning, sanding, priming, painting, and sealing it.

steps.description: Clean and sand the hood to remove grease, old paint, and grime.
actions: Mix Dawn dish soap with hot water in a bucket.
Position the step stool securely.
Clean the hood with a sponge.
Wipe away excess water with a damp cloth.
Allow the hood to dry.
Sand the entire hood with 150-grit sandpaper.
Avoid applying too much pressure.
Wipe the hood with a damp cloth.
Let the hood dry.

steps.description: This step involves taping off edges, priming, and painting the exhaust hood with two coats of primer and two coats of paint.
actions: Tape off all the outside edges using painter’s tape
Pour primer into the paint tray
Use a paintbrush to get the edges and the trim of the exhaust hood
Use a roller to complete the priming process
Apply two layers of metal primer
Let the primer dry as per instructions on the can
Clean the paintbrush and tray
Fill the tray with metal paint
Use a brush to paint the trim
Use a roller to apply two separate coats of paint

steps.description: Apply two layers of sealant to the exhaust hood after the paint has dried to prevent damage.
actions: Apply two layers of sealant
Wait for oil-based paint to dry
Put away your supplies
Avoid cooking on the range top for 24 hours
